meta.name: wayfinder
meta.description: Plan a huge chunk of work — more than one agent session can hold — as a shared map of investigation tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将大型工作拆解为可追踪的调研任务并逐步解决
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把跨会话的大任务拆成可管理的调研工单并逐一完成。
copy.tagline_en: Break large work into trackable investigation tickets and resolve them step by step

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你把一个大任务拆成一张“地图”——在项目的问题追踪器上创建一系列调查工单，然后逐个解决，直到通往目标的路径清晰可见。它默认只做规划，不执行具体工作。
howto.when: 当你有一个模糊的大想法，需要分多个会话才能完成，且路径不清晰时触发。你可以说“我们来规划这个项目”来启动地图绘制，或者提供一个已有地图的链接来继续推进。

say.text: 帮我规划这个新功能：用户登录优化。
say.note: Claude 会先通过对话明确目标，然后创建地图和工单。
Claude 会加载地图，选择下一个可做的工单并解决它。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you break a large task into a 'map' — a set of investigation tickets on your issue tracker — and resolves them one by one until the path to the destination is clear. By default, it plans only, not executes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have a vague, large idea that requires multiple sessions and the path is unclear. You can say 'Let's plan this project' to start charting, or provide a map URL to continue working through it.

say_en.text: Help me plan this new feature: user login optimization.
Continue working through this map: https://github.com/.../issues/1
say_en.note: Claude will load the map, pick the next available ticket, and resolve it.
